definitions.explanation: A comprehensive report published once a year, summarizing an organization's activities, financial performance, or research findings over the past year.

examples.japanese: {年次報告|ねんじほうこく}を{作成|さくせい}する。
{会社|かいしゃ}の{年次報告|ねんじほうこく}{書|しょ}が{公開|こうかい}された。
examples.english: The company's annual report was published.

examples.japanese: {国連|こくれん}の{年次報告|ねんじほうこく}によると、{世界|せかい}の{人口|じんこう}は{増加|ぞうか}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: According to the UN's annual report, the world's population continues to grow.

notes:
A compound of {年次|ねんじ} (annual, yearly) and {報告|ほうこく} (report). Common in business, government, and academic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年次報告|ねんじほうこく}{書|しょ} — annual report (document)
- {年次報告|ねんじほうこく}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する — to submit an annual report
- {年次報告|ねんじほうこく}を{発表|はっぴょう}する — to release an annual report

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年報|ねんぽう} — annual report, yearbook (shorter synonym, also common)
- {決算報告|けっさんほうこく} — financial report (specifically about accounts/finances)
- {年次|ねんじ} — annual (the base modifier)
